# Agent Lightning APO

> Automatic Prompt Optimization for AI agents. APO improves prompts using LLM-generated critiques ("textual gradients") and beam search. This repository (Sparky) provides a visual dashboard for running and analyzing APO results.

## Core Documentation

- [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/sanjeevkumar761/agent-lightning-scio/blob/main/llms-full.txt): Complete reference - all concepts, verified code examples, API documentation
- [README.md](https://github.com/sanjeevkumar761/agent-lightning-scio/blob/main/README.md): Quick start for Sparky dashboard

## How APO Works

- [APO_SECRET_SAUCE.md](https://github.com/sanjeevkumar761/agent-lightning-scio/blob/main/APO_SECRET_SAUCE.md): Textual gradients and beam search algorithm explained
- [AGENT_LIGHTNING_FLOW.md](https://github.com/sanjeevkumar761/agent-lightning-scio/blob/main/AGENT_LIGHTNING_FLOW.md): Visual diagrams of the optimization loop
- [APO_SIMPLE_DEFINITIONS.md](https://github.com/sanjeevkumar761/agent-lightning-scio/blob/main/APO_SIMPLE_DEFINITIONS.md): Plain-English definitions of rollout, reward, datasets

## Integration Guides

- [INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/sanjeevkumar761/agent-lightning-scio/blob/main/INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md): Framework-agnostic integration patterns
- [AGENT_LIGHTNING_CHECKLIST.md](https://github.com/sanjeevkumar761/agent-lightning-scio/blob/main/AGENT_LIGHTNING_CHECKLIST.md): Step-by-step integration checklist

## Working Examples

- [backend/room_selector.py](https://github.com/sanjeevkumar761/agent-lightning-scio/blob/main/backend/room_selector.py): Conference room booking agent with tool calls and LLM-as-judge reward
- [backend/room_selector_apo.py](https://github.com/sanjeevkumar761/agent-lightning-scio/blob/main/backend/room_selector_apo.py): APO training script for room selector
- [backend/wealth_onboarding_apo.py](https://github.com/sanjeevkumar761/agent-lightning-scio/blob/main/backend/wealth_onboarding_apo.py): Compliance agent with weighted reward function
- [backend/room_tasks.jsonl](https://github.com/sanjeevkumar761/agent-lightning-scio/blob/main/backend/room_tasks.jsonl): Example dataset (57 tasks in JSONL format)
- [agent-instrumentation-examples/langgraph-wealth-onboarding/](https://github.com/sanjeevkumar761/agent-lightning-scio/tree/main/agent-instrumentation-examples/langgraph-wealth-onboarding): LangGraph integration example

## Dashboard (Sparky)

- [backend/main.py](https://github.com/sanjeevkumar761/agent-lightning-scio/blob/main/backend/main.py): FastAPI server - parses apo.log, serves metrics via REST API
- [frontend/src/pages/index.tsx](https://github.com/sanjeevkumar761/agent-lightning-scio/blob/main/frontend/src/pages/index.tsx): React dashboard with charts and prompt comparison
